scientific_integrity: The quotient-stack action and automorphism locus were read in Zhao, while the global-quotient fixed-sector and age formalism was checked in Fantechi–Göttsche. Exact group and Hodge bookkeeping is replayable from the embedded script. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The calculation is restricted to a general smooth \((2,2)\)-complete intersection \(V\) over \(\mathbf C\), uses complex Chen–Ruan cohomology, and determines the graded Hodge vector space rather than the full orbifold product. No boundary or nongeneral fiber is covered.
title: Chen–Ruan Hodge diamond of the generic family \(2.19\) forgetful fiber
